senses.gloss: मुर mura, m. N. of a Daitya slain by Viṣṇu 🞄or Kṛṣṇa.

मूर 1. mū-rá, a. [√ mīv] impetuous (horses;
 🞄RV.¹).
मूर 2. mūr-á, a. dull, stupid, foolish (V.).
मूर 3. mū́r-a, n. = मूल mū́la, root (V.).
मुरची muracī, f. N. of a river.
मुरज muraja, m. kind of drum, tabor: 🞄-ka, m. N. of an attendant of Śiva.

मुरजित् mura-jit, m. conqueror of Mura, 🞄ep. of Kṛṣṇa or Viṣṇu;
 -dviṣ, m. foe 🞄of —, -bhid, m. destroyer of —, -mardana, 🞄m. crusher of —, -ripu, m. foe of Mura, id..
मुरवार mura-vāra, m. N. of a prince of 🞄the Turuṣkas.
मुर्छ् MURCH, v. मूर्छ् MŪRCH.

मुर्मुर múr-mur-a, m. expiring ember;
 fire 🞄of chaff.
[मूर् MŪR, become rigid or solid].
मूर्खीभू mūrkhī-bhū, become stupid or silly.
मूर्छित mūrch-ita, (pp.) n. kind of song.
मूर्ण mūr-ṇa, pp. (√ 2. mṛ), crushed, etc..
मूर्त mūr-tá, pp. [√ mūr] v. √ mūuch: -tva, n. 🞄material form, corporeal nature.
मूर्वा mūr-vā, f. kind of hemp (sanseviera 🞄Roxburghiana) of which bowstrings and 🞄Kṣatriyasʼ girdles are made: -maya, a. 🞄made of Mūrvā.
